_surfaces_v2_note: V2 SURFACES+SOFT GOODS pass (scratchpad/hall2/build.py; probe.py solves the skins, wallmeter.py meters every wall over its own probe mask, m.py meters the photo). THE FINDING THAT MATTERS FOR EVERY ROOM: house.js extrudes each wall OUTWARD from its own footprint line, so on a party wall the NEIGHBOUR's 0.35 ft slab lands INSIDE this room and is the surface the camera actually sees. In room 17 that is room 13 over local x 0..0.35 for z -0.10..10.70, room 14 over local z -0.30..0.05, room 16 over local x 7.75..8.10, room 26 over local z 16.45..16.80. Anything mounted against the footprint line renders inside the neighbour's slab and is INVISIBLE -- that is why the round-1 sculpture could not be seen and why the previous skins metered as if absent. build.py's FACE dict / wface() offset every wall-mounted piece onto the visible face. Skins solved by probe: n #6f6f6f -> 169.4, s #f7f7f7 -> 164.4, e #cacaca -> 157.6, w #b2b2b2 -> 176.1 (photo: west wall 171-182, north 165.7, ceiling 144-148). Ceiling emissive dropped to #5c5c5c -> 148.7 (kit.CEIL's #b0b0b0 gave 207.7). Runner: 3-tone basketweave height field, 200.4/197.2 north and 166.7 south against the photo's 181.2.
_runner_note: Hall2F Floor Runner has failed three ways, all from REGULARITY: r1 full-width cylinders over a slab (piano keyboard), r2 a light/dark pair across straight ropes (painted stripes), r3 a basketweave on a straight lattice (a floor GRATE from the plan/doll poses).  It is now a quasi-periodic sum of five waves in five directions with mutually irrational periods, so no rib ever crosses the rug; the three tones are picked from that same height field so they are blobs following the wool, not cells following the mesh; cell split diagonals alternate; and the tone range is 18 levels, not 40.
